text: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), Freshman Year. Freshman first semester: Introduction to CS & SE (CS 1200); Introduction to Engineering & CS (ECS 1100); Calculus I (Math 2413 or 2417); Computer Science I (CS 1337); 6 hours CORE; and Freshman Seminar (UNIV 1010). Freshman second semester: Computer Science II (CS 2336 or 2337); Discrete Mathematics I (CS 2305); Calculus II (Math 2414 or 2419); Mechanics and Heat (Phys 2325); Mechanics and Heat Lab (Phys 2125); and 3 hours CORE. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met.

text: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), Sophomore Year. Sophomore first semester: Mathematics Foundations of SE (SE 3306); Computer Architecture (SE 2340); Electricity and Magnetism (Phys 2326); Electricity and Magnetism Lab (Phys 2126); and 6 hours CORE. Sophomore second semester: Probability & Statistics in CS (SE 3341); Algorithms Analysis & Data Structures (SE 3345); C/C++ Programming in a UNIX Environment (SE 3377); Linear Algebra (Math 2418); and 3 hours CORE. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met.
source_title: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan, 2021-2022 Catalog
section_heading: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan: Sophomore Year

text: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), Junior and Senior Years. Junior first semester: Software Engineering (SE 3354); Operating Systems (SE 4348); SE Guided Elective (SE 43XX); Professional & Technical Communication (ECS 3390); and 3 hours CORE. The two middle upper-division semesters (junior second semester and senior first semester) consist of one semester of Software Project Planning & Management (SE 4381), Software Architecture & Design (SE 4352), 3 hours SE Guided Elective (SE 43XX), Database Systems (SE 4347), and Professional Responsibility in CS & SE (SE/CS 3162), and another semester of Software Testing, Verification, Validation, QA (SE 4367), Requirements Engineering (SE 4351), 3 hours SE Guided Elective (SE/CS 43XX), 3 hours Free Elective (see advisor), and 3 hours CORE. Senior final semester: Software Engineering Project (SE 4485); 3 hours SE Guided Elective (SE 43XX); 4 hours Free Elective (see advisor); and Core Curriculum Assessment (UNIV 2020). At least two of four of the upper-division SE courses marked on the flowchart must be complete to begin the Project.
source_title: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan, 2021-2022 Catalog
section_heading: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan: Junior and Senior Years

text: The BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog) includes 12 hours of Domains and Guided Electives. Students should complete three courses from one of the application domains; see the document entitled "Application Domains." Further guided electives can be selected from the CS/SE 43xx level classes. The plan advises that by the junior year, you should choose a domain. See an advisor for guided elective and free elective choices.
source_title: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan, 2021-2022 Catalog
section_heading: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan: Domains and Guided Electives

text: In the BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2021-2022 Catalog), a grade of C- or better is needed in Math 2413 or Math 2417 to move forward. A grade of C or better is required for CS 1336, CS 1337, CS 2305, and CS 2336. Math 2312 (C or better) or 80% on ALEKS is listed as the prerequisite for starting Calculus I. The flowchart also shows CS 1336/1136 alongside CS 1337 and Math 2413/2414 alongside Math 2417/2419 in the freshman year. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met.
source_title: BS Software Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan, 2021-2022 Catalog
